Estimated served items:
- 2 fried eggs: about 180 kcal (14 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat)
- Grilled tomato: about 20 kcal
- 3 small mushrooms: about 10 kcal
- Toast slice (sourdough): about 120 kcal (4 g protein, 22 g carbs, 1 g fat)
- Avocado, about a third of a fruit: about 80 kcal (1 g protein, 4 g carbs, 7 g fat)
- Lemon wedge: about 3 kcal
- Latte, about 250 ml of milk: about 120 kcal (6 g protein, 9 g carbs, 6 g fat)

Total served is about 533 kcal, which I round to 530.

Leftovers: only the lemon wedge remains, plus trace residue of oil and food on the plates and some coffee in the mug. That is about 10 kcal.

Eaten: 530 − 10 = 520 kcal.

Macros eaten, summed from the items above, are about 25 g protein, 40 g carbs and 30 g fat.
